xuxulim: Xuxulim — Xuxulim, in Xuxulim Ha 'Xuxulim House', the second house of trial; kept as a name; Brasseur's note takes it as the north wind or its shivering ('la bise ou le frémissement du vent du nord'), inferred
teu: tew — cold; noun (ꜩaꜩ chi teu vpam 'thick with cold its inside'; tew is the modern word)
xuruxuh: xuruxuj — (guess) a sound word, 'rattling' perhaps; not otherwise known, repeats its sounds (xu-ru-xuh); respelled letter for letter
caracoh: karakoj — (guess) a sound word, not otherwise known; repeats its sounds (ca-ra-coh); in cac caracoh, a doubtful phrase left out of the English (Brasseur zakcaracoh); respelled letter for letter
xurulah: xurulaj — (guess) a sound word, 'whistling' perhaps; not otherwise known, repeats its sounds (xu-ru-lah); respelled letter for letter
chupam: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside' (the m spelling of chupan)
balami: B'alami — Jaguar (in B'alami Ja 'Jaguar House'); b'alam 'jaguar' + -i, joined to ja 'house'; translated as a description
quichouic: kichowik — (inferred) milling about, mingling; sense after Brasseur ('they mingled'); respelled by the letters
matat: matat — (guess) not otherwise known; read 'fiercely' after Brasseur ('with a fierce air'); respelled letter for letter
tit: tit — (guess) not otherwise known, perhaps 'teeth' or 'grin' (read qui tit 'their teeth(?)', 'bared their teeth'), after Brasseur ('grinning'); a doubtful reading (t and h look alike in the hand); respelled letter for letter
ꜩapim: tz'apim — (inferred) shut in, closed; participle of tz'ap 'shut, close' (Brasseur 'enfermés'); the modern word is tz'apij; also written ꜩapin
ꜩoꜩi: Tzotzi — Bat (in Tzotzi Ja 'Bat House'); tzotz 'bat' + -i, noun + -i + ja 'house', built like B'alami Ja; the modern word for the bat is sotz', so only the letters are respelled
ꜩoꜩ: tzotz — bat; noun (Brasseur zotz, 'chauves-souris'); respelled by the letters, since the modern form of Ximénez's word is not certain (sotz')
ꜩiꜩotic: tzitzotik — (guess) shrieking, screeching; a sound word, after Brasseur ('crying'); a doubtful reading (MS ꜩiꜩohic), decided with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
ꜩitilahic: tzitilajik — (guess) fluttering, beating the wings; a sound word, after Brasseur ('beating their wings'); a doubtful reading (MS ꜩih'lahic), decided with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
ropop: ropop — (inferred) fly about, flutter; after Brasseur ('voltigeant'); respelled by the letters
ꜩapin: tz'apin — (inferred) shut in, closed; the same word as ꜩapim, written with n; participle of tz'ap 'shut, close'
roo: Roo — (uncertain) its fifth; r- 'its' + o(o), taken as 'five' from its place in the list (inferred); Brasseur Roo; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
chaim: Chaim — Chaim, in Chaim Ja 'House of Blades (?)', the fifth house of trial; cha 'blade, obsidian point' + -im (unexplained) + ja 'house'; 'House of Blades' is inferred (Brasseur's introduction 'la Maison des Lances d'Obsidienne'; his French here 'maison des combattants', his text Chayim-ha)
chaꜫol: chaq'ol — (uncertain) meaning not known, left in K'iche' in the English; a doubtful reading (a q-shaped letter taken as the tresillo, a blot on the next); Brasseur reads chakol (his k is plain q) and renders 'victors'
leloh: leloj — (guess) gleaming; not otherwise known; zac leloh re is a doubtful division; respelled by the letters
ꜩininic: tzininik — (guess) clashing, a sound word; after chi; the make-up is not known; respelled by the letters
yohohic: yojojik — (guess) grinding, a sound word; after chi; the make-up is not known; respelled by the letters
aon: Aon — (uncertain) 'where' (inferred), repeating apa after Brasseur, who renders 'where' twice; possibly a form of apa; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
xhe: xje — (doubtful) a verb before yaoc, read 'went' (xhe yaoc 'that was given') after Brasseur, who reads x-be (xb'e); the manuscript has h; printed as written and respelled by the letters
xquec: Xkek — (uncertain) not understood, left out of the English; the letters are clear in the manuscript but Brasseur does not print it as a word; respelled by the letters
xvꜭhax: xuch'ax — was spoken to, was asked; x- completive + vꜭhax (ch'a 'speak' + passive -x, as in xe vꜭhax 'they were told'), here without the plural e-
quizo: k'iso — finish it, use it up; k'is 'finish, end' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb at the end of its clause (xca quizo 'we have used them up'; Brasseur ka qizo)
iꜫih: iq'ij — your day, your days; i- 'your (pl.)' + q'ij 'day, sun'; the span of their life, perhaps their lot (inferred); q-shaped letter read as the tresillo, after Brasseur (gih)
cup: kup — (guess) be cut open; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('cut in the chest'); respelled by the letters
vevah: wewaj — (inferred) hide, be hidden; taken as eu 'hide' (as in euaxibal 'the place of hiding') + -ah, with a v- before it, perhaps v- 'it'; Brasseur reads x-ch'yv'euah and renders 'enseveli' ('buried'); respelled by the letters
ivach: iwach — your (pl.) face; i- 'your (pl.)' + wach 'face', possessed noun
puzic: pusik — (inferred) being sacrificed; puz 'sacrifice' + -ic, as in quix puzic 'you are sacrificed'; the sense of puz is not fully certain (Brasseur 'sacrifiés')
pucbal: Pukb'al — Pucbal, in Pukb'al Chaj, a place name; kept as a name; Brasseur takes it as 'the place where ashes are put down', pucbal a place noun in -bal (inferred)
vnimal: unimal — his elder (brother); u- 'his' + nim 'great' + -al (the nimal 'greatness' of earlier parts), set against vchac 'his younger brother' (inferred)
xmuquic: xmuqik — it was buried, he was buried; x- completive + muq 'bury' + -ik; passive
tiquil: tikil — (inferred) planted, standing; tik 'plant' (as in xchicatiquiba 'we shall plant') + -il; after Brasseur ('the tree in the middle of the road')
xvachin: xwachin — (inferred) it bore fruit; wach 'face, fruit' + -in made a verb, with x- completive, after Brasseur ('se couvrit de fruits')
choco: choko — (inferred) before it went in; ch- + ok 'enter' + -o, in maha choco 'not yet it enters'; respelled by the letters
chuxol: chuxol — in among, among; chi + u- 'its' + xol 'among', relational noun
zima: sima — calabash tree, calabash (round fruit); Brasseur 'tzima'; the manuscript has plain z, so the toggle respells the letter as written; the modern word is presumably tz'ima'
cohcha: kojcha — we say, we call; k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we' + cha 'say' (Brasseur koh cha)
xumaihah: xumaijaj — he marvelled at it; x- completive + u- 'he' + maijaj 'marvel at' (inferred), singular; respelled by the letters
colocac: kolokak — (guess) round; perhaps the coloquic 'round' of the last part, after Brasseur (colocak); respelled by the letters
hunam: junam — alike, the same; jun 'one' + -am (inferred); Brasseur 'of the same kind'
caiih: kaiij — (inferred) look at (it); in qui caiih 'they look at it', after Brasseur (qui cayih, 'lorsqu'ils allaient le considérer'); a doubtful reading (no descender for a y); respelled by the letters
xux: xux — it became; x- completive + ux 'become'
xubanic: xub'anik — it was done, it happened; x- completive + u- + b'an 'do' + -ik (inferred)
chupuvic: chupuwik — (guess) pick, take; not otherwise known (perhaps ch- + upuv + -ic); the sense is a guess from context; respelled by the letters
naipu: naypu — likewise, also; nai + pu, as naipuch is naypuch; written as one word
catah: kataj — (inferred) forbid; after Brasseur ('forbidding one another'); respelled by the letters
hunamatal: junamatal — made alike, one with; junam 'alike' + -atal, participle of state (inferred)
xuta: xuta — he heard it, she heard it; x- completive + u- 'he, she' + ta 'hear'
capoh: q'apoj — maiden, young woman; noun, written with plain c where Brasseur reads gapoh (his g is ꜫ); the q' is restored (inferred)
roponic: roponik — her arrival, her coming; r- 'her' + opon 'arrive there' + -ik, verbal noun

__broaden__.puz: pus — sacred power (exact sense uncertain); often connected with sacrifice · pus — (inferred) sacrifice, be sacrificed; xe puz 'they were sacrificed', Brasseur 'sacrifiés'
__broaden__.xcat: xk'at — it burned; x- completive + k'at 'burn' (the root of k'atanalaj); also in xe cat 'they burned' · xq'at — it was cut off; x- completive + q'at 'cut', as in q'atol 'cutters'; plain c where Brasseur has g (ꜫ)

__broaden__.humah: jumaj — some; jun 'one' + maj, inferred · jumaj — all alike (inferred); in humah colocac vvach 'every fruit round'
__broaden__.rilo: rilo — that he see (it); r- 'he, it' before a vowel + il 'see' + -o · rilo — he sees it; r- 'he' + il 'see' + -o, in a narrative clause, not a wish
__broaden__.quil: kil — it is seen (inferred); il 'see' with k-, in xa k'o kil kakiye; not clear · kil — (inferred) hold back; in xqui quil quib 'they held one another back', after Brasseur ('defending themselves')
